description: Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply - Order to acquire the land in Godigamuwa, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District & 3 other lands for water projects
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains multiple orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties (land allotments) for infrastructure projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of land parcels, their boundaries, locations, and extent (measured in perches), which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While a government minister is named, this is incidental to the core land acquisition purpose rather than being about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
